content.introduction: GeekWire is a technology news website based in Seattle that covers startups and established technology companies. It was founded in 2011 by journalists Todd Bishop and John Cook with investment from Jonathan Sposato. Recent news includes Alaska Air's sustainability strategy, Ravel's $8.2M funding for clothing recycling, and Shield AI's plans to build an AI-piloted fighter jet in Washington state, adding 4,000 jobs by the early 2030s. The site also reports on significant departures from Microsoft and LinkedIn, and the latest in the Pacific Northwest startup index.

Description: GeekWire is a fast-growing, national technology news site with strong roots in the Seattle region and a large audience of loyal, tech-savvy readers around the globe, who follow the site for breaking news, expert analysis and unique insights into the technology industry. Founded in 2011, GeekWire is uniquely positioned to cover some of the most widely followed and innovative tech companies in the world, and one of the most vibrant startup markets in the country.
